boxes.title: Record the failed attempt
boxes.plain: A TransientError counts as a failed attempt. With tries left (MAX_ATTEMPTS, 4 by default) the job returns to pending with a delay. Out of tries, it is failed for good.
boxes.why: Keeps a flaky carrier from losing parcels while still stopping a hopeless one.

boxes.title: Wait out the backoff
boxes.plain: The retry cannot be claimed until now plus base times 2 to the (attempt minus 1) seconds: 2, 4, 8 by default, capped at 300.

boxes.title: Terminal failure
boxes.plain: No tries left: the job is failed for good and the report counts it as a dead letter. Reached by the last failed attempt, or by a lease that expired on the last attempt.

boxes.title: Customs hold
boxes.plain: A declared value over CUSTOMS_LIMIT_CENTS (50000 by default) parks the job in hold. Only an operator's release request with paperwork moves it.
boxes.why: Customs paperwork arrives outside the system.
boxes.failure: Waits until a later release request arrives

boxes.title: Address hold
boxes.plain: A ZZ postcode parks the job in hold as an address hold. The release command answers still on hold for these, and no other code moves a job out of hold.
boxes.why: The region cannot be verified automatically.
boxes.failure: The web client's wait ends in PollTimeout for a held job

boxes.title: Release a customs hold
boxes.plain: A later operator request. A customs hold with paperwork given is released and marked cleared so routing lets it through. Without paperwork the answer is still on hold (customs).
outputs: released, or still on hold with the reason

boxes.title: Answer still on hold
boxes.plain: For an address hold the release command only answers still on hold (address) and changes nothing. No release is written for address holds.
outputs: ok false with the hold reason
